questions.text: What persistence layer should todo-stream use for todos and the append-only event log?
options: Single SQLite file with WAL mode
Plain JSONL append-only file plus in-memory index
Postgres via libpq for multi-user setups

questions.text: How should the 'stream' side expose real-time updates to clients and other processes?
options: stdout NDJSON lines for pipe-friendly consumption
Unix domain socket with line-delimited JSON
Local HTTP server with Server-Sent Events
tail -f style file watch on the event log

questions.text: What is the primary CLI invocation model users should expect?
options: Long-running daemon plus thin client subcommands
Interactive TUI as the default entry point
Hybrid: one-shot commands plus optional 'stream' follow mode

questions.text: What is the v0.1 scope for multi-device or multi-user synchronization?
options: Git-backed sync of the event log
Optional self-hosted relay server over HTTP

questions.text: What fields and semantics define a todo in the v0.1 data model?
options: Add due date and project/list grouping
Add parent_id for subtasks and dependencies
Full GTD: contexts, projects, energy, next-action flag

answers.choice: Single SQLite file with WAL mode
stdout NDJSON lines for pipe-friendly consumption
